name: tracking_platform_id comment: 关联追踪平台 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_status_code comment: 平台一级状态(tag/state) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_status_meaning comment: 一级状态含义 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_sub_code comment: 平台二级状态(subtag/statusCode) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: platform_sub_meaning comment: 二级状态含义 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: internal_status comment: Looply内部状态 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: display_i18n_key comment: i18n key(国际平台用，对应subtag) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: sort_order comment: 排序 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: updated_at comment: 更新时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: message_logs comment: 消息记录 note: 记录四种数据流：业务系统请求/Looply请求物流平台/物流平台Webhook回调/推送业务系统消息 columns: - name: id comment: 消息ID constraint: PRIMARY KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: shipment_id comment: 关联运单 constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: direction comment: 数据流向(inbound_api/outbound_platform/inbound_webhook/outbound_push) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: source comment: 来源方 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: target comment: 目标方 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: event comment: 事件名(registerTracking/createTracking/tracking_update/statusNotify) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: request_payload comment: 请求报文JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: response_payload comment: 响应报文JSON constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: http_status comment: HTTP状态码 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: latency_ms comment: 响应耗时(ms) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: status comment: 处理状态(成功/失败) constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: error_message comment: 错误信息 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: triggered_by comment: 触发来源消息ID constraint: FOREIGN KEY type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: - name: created_at comment: 创建时间 constraint: type: nullable: default: enum_values: index: relations: - from: shipments to: tracking_checkpoints type: 1:N label: 轨迹节点 color: '#1976D2' - from: carriers to: shipments type: 1:N label: 承运 color: '#43A047' - from: tracking_platforms to: shipments type: 1:N label: 路由到平台 color: '#43A047' style: dashed - from: tracking_platforms to: platform_carrier_mappings type: 1:N label: 映射的承运商 color: '#43A047' - from: carriers to: platform_carrier_mappings type: 1:N label: 在多平台的代码 color: '#43A047' - from: tracking_platforms to: status_mappings type: 1:N label: 状态映射 color: '#43A047' - from: shipments to: message_logs type: 1:N label: 消息记录 color: '#8E24AA' - from: message_logs to: message_logs type: 1:N label: 触发(triggered_by) color: '#8E24AA' style: dashed design_rules: service_positioning: 系统定位为内部物流信息获取服务平台，为其他业务系统提供标准化物流信息查询服务。运单通过 API 注册，不直接关联订单实体 unified_shipments: shipments 统一管理国内/国际运单，不再区分。系统根据承运商→追踪平台映射自动路由到对应平台(AfterShip/快递100) carrier_split: 同一物流公司如同时有国内外服务则拆成独立承运商记录（如顺丰国内 sf-domestic / 顺丰国际 sf-international），不使用 scope 字段 status_mapping_universal: status_mappings 不再限制平台类型。每行对应一个 subtag/statusCode 级别映射。AfterShip 的 subtag 始终存在（无具体 subtag 时 fallback 到 _001 变体），因此只需一个 display_i18n_key 字段 status_mapping_lookup: 查找顺序：先精确匹配 platform_status_code + platform_sub_code，匹配不到则 fallback 到仅 platform_status_code 的行 i18n_optional: display_i18n_key 仅国际平台(AfterShip)使用，对应 subtag 级别。国内平台(快递100)该字段为 NULL，前台轨迹文案直接使用原始 message 字段 message_log_directions: message_logs.direction 四种值：inbound_api(业务系统→Looply)、outbound_platform(Looply→物流平台)、inbound_webhook(物流平台→Looply)、outbound_push(Looply→业务系统) message_chain: message_logs.triggered_by 建立消息因果链：业务系统请求 → 触发 Looply请求物流平台；物流平台Webhook回调 → 触发 推送业务系统消息 checkpoint_mapping: tracking_checkpoints 接收 Webhook 时立即完成状态映射，存储 mapped_internal_status。国际段额外存储 display_i18n_key，国内段该字段为 NULL encryption: API Key/Secret 字段必须加密存储（AES-256） webhook_dedup: tracking_checkpoints 通过联合唯一索引 (shipment_id, checkpoint_time, platform_tag, message) 去重 platform_routing: 运单注册时根据 carrier_id → platform_carrier_mappings → tracking_platform_id 自动路由到对应追踪平台 courier_redirect_link: AfterShip 推送中包含 courier_redirect_link（承运商轨迹跳转链接），Looply 在状态通知中透传给业务系统，供用户端跳转查看承运商官方轨迹页面
